# 1. Consolidate Minor Theme (并省合治 / 合并小军区)
oe_t2_consolidate_theme = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = never
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            tag = BYZ
            is_rebel_country = no
            any_subject = { count >= 2 oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = no }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_auth_5_tt var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            oe_t2_can_be_consolidated_recipient = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_small_jurisdiction_tt oe_theme_jurisdiction_size <= 7 }
            at_war = no
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_t2_choose_receiving_theme"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_t2_no_receiving_theme"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            oe_theme_convertible_trigger = yes
            NOT = { this = scope:recipient }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
            oe_t2_adjacent_distance_band = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_receiver_loyal_tt OR = { var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2 var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3 } }
            at_war = no
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:target }
            oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -5 }
            scope:actor = { oe_t2_do_consolidate_theme = yes }
        }
    }
}

# 2. Split Co-Administered Theme (析置新军区 / 拆分兼管辖区)
oe_t2_split_theme = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = never
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            tag = BYZ
            is_rebel_country = no
            any_subject = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_seat }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = no has_raised_levies = no }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_auth_10_tt var:oe_pillars_authority >= 10 }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_region
            has_variable = oe_t2_absorbed_seat
        }
        enabled = {
            at_war = no
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_split_seat_owned_tt var:oe_t2_absorbed_seat ?= { has_owner = yes owner ?= c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient scope:recipient = { oe_t2_can_split_theme = yes } }
            oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -10 }
            scope:recipient = { oe_t2_do_split_theme = yes }
        }
    }
}

# 3. Rotate Strategoi (易镇调防 / 双督对调 — Art 1 of 御将4术)
oe_t2_rotate_strategoi = {
    type = subject
    category = CATEGORY_SUBJECT_ACTIONS
    use_enroute = no
    ai_tick = never
    potential = {
        scope:actor = {
            tag = BYZ
            is_rebel_country = no
            any_subject = { count >= 2 oe_theme_member_trigger = yes }
        }
    }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = { at_war = no gold >= 50 }
        international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_auth_5_tt var:oe_pillars_authority >= 5 }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
            NOT = { oe_ts_despot = yes }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
            has_ruler = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_t2_rotate_cd } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_tenure_4_tt oe_theme_tenure_years >= 4 }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_band_1_plus_tt OR = { var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 1 var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2 var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3 } }
        }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = country
        interaction_source_list = {
            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_t2_choose_rotate_partner"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_t2_no_rotate_partner"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = {
            oe_t2_rotate_partner_ok = yes
        }
        enabled = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_cd_ready_tt NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_t2_rotate_cd } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_t2_band_1_plus_tt OR = { var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 1 var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 2 var:oe_theme_loyalty_band ?= 3 } }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = scope:recipient
                exists = scope:target
                scope:recipient = { has_ruler = yes }
                scope:target = { has_ruler = yes }
            }
            oe_t2_change_auth = { amount = -5 }
            scope:actor = {
                add_gold = -50
                oe_t2_do_rotate_strategoi = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

        looking_for_a = country

            scope:actor = { every_subject = { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_country"
        default_sort = will
        column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
        visible = {
            oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_tg_hereditary }
            NOT = { oe_ts_charter = yes }
        }
        enabled = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_theme_revolt_now }
            custom_tooltip = {
                text = oe_t2_hereditary_req_tt
                OR = {
                    oe_ts_frontier = yes
                    is_subject_type = oe_empire_theme_frontier

            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
            scope:actor = { oe_t2_do_confirm_hereditary = yes }
        }
    }
